text:
If you love me, love me whole,

not by zones of light or shadow...

if you love me, love me black

and white. And gray, and green, and blond,

love me day,

love me night...

And dawn at the open window!


If you love me, do not cut me down:

love all of me... or do not love me!

translation.title: If You Love Me, Love Me Whole...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps Loynaz's demand to be loved without dividing or trimming the self.
